answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks agents that forge identities at scale. Each slot needs a 50-credit deposit in a dune queue, where three peers replay work before payment. To open a slot, an attacker locks a fresh 50 credits and faces the same replay; a rented replay burns it and leaves an ember mark barring that key for one epoch. 1,000 fake identities lock 50,000 credits, over the 40,000-credit pool. Honest agents pay 50 once and keep full reward.
